admission.justification: A re-pointed row that kept its stale value published a wrong fingerprint; both parameters of the recompute case compare the committed value with an independently computed digest.

applicability: The entity-fingerprint refresh of a converted leaf's closeout.
conditions: A row is recomputed when its evidence touches a changed path, when its evidence list differs from the same row at the leaf's memory base, or when the base holds no such row.
The value is git-blob-set-v1 over the evidence set at the code commit's tree.
exclusions: Rows of a catalog the leaf's memory base already holds unchanged in evidence and untouched by a changed path.
A curator, who never computes or writes a fingerprint.

evidence: the same focused test module, both parameters of test_a_repointed_row_is_recomputed_and_the_closeout_lands; the unchanged-files-only parameter fails on 05aaec05 with the stale sha256:000... value and passes here, and the value is compared with an independent Git computation

statement: A row whose evidence list the leaf edits is recomputed at closeout, and the value is the git-blob-set-v1 digest over the new set at the code commit's tree.
